description: Set one action's stage with the expected version: off (never proposed), review (a person approves each use) or automatic (may run without a person when the company policy and the agent's checks allow). Automatic needs a person's delegated messaging.activate grant. A task action at automatic also needs described_accepted: true. Money, identity, clinical and other person-only actions cannot be automatic. A failed or uncertain automatic run moves the action back to review on its own.
